A critical view
Benefits and challenges
Benefits
  • Fewer new clothes
  • Longer life
  • Less waste
Challenges
  • Shipping & cleaning emissions
  • Rebound effect
  • Costly inventory
  • Niche market
Renting beats fast fashion, but resale or wearing clothes longer is greener. Source: The Ethos
